caseName: New Motor Vehicle Board v. Orrin W. Fox Co.
caseNameFull: New Motor Vehicle Board of California v. Orrin W. Fox Co. and Northern California Motor Car Dealers Assn. v. Orrin W. Fox Co.

opinions.text: D. C. C. D. Cal. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 434 U. S. 1060.] Motion of National Automobile Dealers Assn, for leave to file a brief out of time as amicus curiae denied. Motion of appellants in No. 77-849 for additional time for oral argument denied; alternative request for divided argument granted.
